ABOUT US
Navkis College of Engineering (NCEH)
is a professionally governed technical institution committed to 
          academic excellence, ethical values, innovation, research orientation, and holistic student development.
Established in
2009–10
by the
Yagachi Education and Research Trust
, and functioning under the 
          patronage of the
Navkis Group of Institutions, Bengaluru since 2019–20
, the institution draws strength 
          from a strong educational legacy, progressive leadership, and a quality-driven governance framework.
The College is approved by
AICTE
, affiliated to
Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU), Belagavi
, 
          and recognized under
Section 2(f) of the UGC Act
. All academic and administrative processes are carried out 
          in strict compliance with statutory and regulatory requirements.
Located in a serene and picturesque campus at Hassan, Navkis College of Engineering provides an intellectually 
          stimulating academic ambience supported by state-of-the-art infrastructure, modern laboratories, ICT-enabled 
          classrooms, robust digital systems, and comprehensive student support facilities.
Academic Programs
Navkis College of Engineering offers a balanced portfolio of eight (8) academic programs at undergraduate and 
          postgraduate levels, designed as per AICTE norms, VTU curriculum frameworks, and NEP–2020 principles.

Chairman Message
CHAIRMAN
MESSAGE
Welcome to Navkis College of Engineering and family of Navkis!
I extend my warmest greetings to you all. I welcome you to a new chapter in our quest to provide the best of education with a strong industry outlook through the unraveling of Navkis College of Engineering, Hassan. Embarking on this journey that started in 2000 through the first institution of Navkis in Bangalore, I am proud to say that the unwavering commitment, effort and experience of our teachers, parents and students have ensured Navkis to grow into a brand of quality and substance.
Carrying the torch lit by my father, Late Sri. M.S Ramaiah who set up the Ramaiah group of institutions, being one of the front runners in quality education in India, Navkis College of Engineering, Hassan aims at continuing this legacy.
I believe that education is the most powerful tool that can shape a country’s growth and its future. Hence, it is our responsibility as educators, to ensure that students are provided with a strong platform to build and nurture their skills and values in order to positively contribute to oneself and the social environment around them. Navkis College of Engineering Hassan aims at putting this thought to practice.
My vision for Navkis College of Engineering (NCE), Hassan, is to become a renowned engineering college to nurture agile and knowledgeable engineers.
Our core values of service, quality, innovation and harmony form the foundation for Navkis college of Engineering. We believe that today’s students are tomorrow’s leaders and therefore ensure that no stone is left unturned when it comes to equipping, exposing, enabling, empowering and enlightening our students. Here, students from rural, sub urban and tier 2 and 3 areas have access to a premium technical education institution in order to have a successful career ahead. Focusing on the three pillars of infrastructure, human resource and industry networks, we have ensured that students are provided a platform to aspire, achieve and excel.
Come and experience student life at Navkis and take a further step towards achieving your goal.
Shri. M. R. Anandram
Chairman Navkis group of institutions

PRINCIPAL MESSAGE
Home
About Us
PRINCIPAL MESSAGE
PRINCIPAL
MESSAGE
Welcome to our Navkis Engineering Institution.
It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to our institution, a place where knowledge, innovation, and values come together to shape the engineers and leaders of tomorrow. Our college is committed to providing quality technical education that empowers students with the knowledge, skills, and ethical values necessary to excel in a rapidly evolving global environment.
Engineering is not merely about acquiring technical knowledge; it is about solving real-world problems through creativity, innovation, and a commitment to excellence. At our institution, we strive to create an academic ecosystem that nurtures critical thinking, encourages research and innovation, and promotes lifelong learning. Our curriculum is complemented by modern laboratories, industry collaborations, internships, skill development programs, and project-based learning to ensure that our graduates are industry-ready and socially responsible.
We strongly believe that holistic education extends beyond the classroom. Students are encouraged to participate in co-curricular and extracurricular activities, professional societies, entrepreneurship initiatives, sports, cultural events, and community outreach programs. These experiences help develop leadership qualities, teamwork, communication skills, and a sense of social responsibility.
Our dedicated faculty members are committed to mentoring students and fostering an environment of academic excellence, integrity, and continuous improvement. We emphasize innovation, interdisciplinary learning, and collaboration with industry and research organizations to prepare our students for the challenges and opportunities of the future.
As we continue our journey towards academic excellence, we remain steadfast in our mission to produce competent engineers, innovative thinkers, ethical professionals, and responsible citizens who contribute meaningfully to society and nation-building.
I invite aspiring students, parents, alumni, industry partners, and all stakeholders to become a part of our vibrant academic community. Together, let us build a future driven by knowledge, innovation, and excellence.
I wish every student a rewarding educational journey filled with learning, discovery, and success.
Best Wishes
Dr Sanjay Pande MB

Computer Science & Engineering
The Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) at NCE, Hassan is very well aware of the
                  fact that Computer Science Engineering drives the world and has become an indispensable part of human
                  civilization. Prospective computer engineers are supervised and guided by experts to study and solve
                  complex problems in computing in all walks of human endeavour especially in business, science,
                  medicine, and education sector. The booming IT sector in India today has plenty of jobs for fresh
                  computer science engineers. So the field of computer science gives never ending opportunities fresh
                  graduates. This programme study encompasses a variety of topics that relates to computation, like
                  development of algorithms, analysis of algorithms, programming languages, software design and computer
                  hardware. Computer Science Engineering has roots in Electrical engineering, Mathematics, and
                  Linguistics.
VISION
To become a renowned education and research center producing globally competent
                          Computer Science Engineers
MISSION
To establish excellent environment and facilities for knowledge dissemination and
                            generation
To promote interactions with industry and institutions of higher learning
To advance research and entrepreneurship
To inculcate professional ethics and social responsibilities
PROGRAM EDUCATIONAL OBJECTIVES (PEOS):
Our graduates in a span of 3 to 5 years after graduation shall:
Serve as successful professionals in software industries or become entrepreneurs using
                                the knowledge of Computer Science and Engineering
Pursue research leading to knowledge enhancement and innovations and/or acquire higher
                                degrees in the field of Computer Science and Engineering
Engage in solving technical/societal problems and practice professional ethics
PROGRAM SPECIFIC OUTCOMES (PSOS):
1. Apply the knowledge of Computer Science & Engineering to analyze problems and design
                              computer based solutions to solve problems
2. Build applications utilizing the practical knowledge of programming, and software
                              tools, following standard practices
INFRASTRUCTURE
The Department of Computer Science & Engineering at NCE offers 4 years (8 Semesters) B.E.
                            course with an intake of 60 students. The department is equipped with all necessary
                            infrastructure and laboratory facilities to conduct the course as per the University
                            prescribed curriculum. The department has well-qualified, experienced and dedicated faculty
                            who are involved in research. Faculty regularly attend Workshops and Faculty Development
                            Programs to keep themselves updated with emerging technologies. A number of Workshops,
                            Seminars and Invited lectures from experts from academia and industry are conducted in the
                            department on cutting edge technologies for the benefit of the faculty and the students.
                            Students also attend Workshops and Conferences conducted by different organizations. The
                            department conducts an array of activities like Quizzes, Programming Tests, Aptitude Tests,
                            under the banner
Linux Forum.
Students are encouraged to participate in competitions
                            conducted by various organizations and many win prizes and bring laurels to the department.
                            The department runs a
Wall Magazine
where students share information on latest
                            technologies.
                            The department also brings out a
News Letter
where students and faculty publish
                            articles
                            related to computer science and engineering. Results are on the higher side. Final year
                            results are consistently above 95%. A number of eligible students get placed in the Campus
                            Placement. The department strives for the all-round development of the students.

DEPARTMENT OF CIVIL ENGINEERING
At NCE, the Department of Civil Engineering is spearheaded by a highly experienced Professor and
                  backed by a team of well qualified and experienced faculty members. The Department organizes in
                  periodical intervals and as per the requirement of the course Technical talks by experts from the
                  industry and academia. These talks and interactions benefit the students in a large way. The
                  Department also arranges technical visits which in turn benefit the student and offers him/her a
                  practical knowledge of the course.
VISION
To become a highly reputed education and research center preparing globally
                          competent Civil Engineers to meet the current and future challenges.
MISSION
To provide quality education emphasizing on emerging technologies through competent
                            faculty and state-of-the-art resources
To foster interaction with industry and institutes of higher learning
To encourage research and entrepreneurship
To inculcate professional ethics and social responsibilities
CURRICULUM
The Department of Civil Engineering at NCE offers 4 years (8 Semesters) B.E. course with an
                            intake of 60 students. The department is equipped with all necessary infrastructure and
                            laboratory facilities to conduct the course as per the University prescribed curriculum. The
                            Department of Civil Engineering at NCE is equipped with facilities to undertake Research and
                            Consultancy projects from Government and Private organizations. Many consultancy works like
                            Soil testing, Material Testing like Concrete and Steel, Water analysis have been undertaken.
                            This enables the students to get an exposure to the industry practices. The department
                            association
Techcon
conducts a number of
Co-curricular activities
like
                            Workshops, Invited
                            Lectures, Site Visits, Technical Talks by students, Students are encouraged to participate
                            in competitions conducted by various organizations. The department association runs a
Wall
                              Magazine
where students share information on latest technologies. The department also
                            brings
                            out a
News Letter
where students and faculty publish articles related to civil
                            engineering
                            and related domains. Every year a
Survey Camp
is conducted for 10 days as a part of
                            the
                            curriculum where the students learn the techniques of surveying. Results are on the higher
                            side. Most of the eligible students get placed on-campus as well as off-campus. The
                            department strives for all-round development of the students.
PEOS AND PSOS
Program Outcomes (POs)
At the end of the B.E program, students are expected to have developed the following
                              outcomes.
1. Engineering Knowledge:
Apply the knowledge of mathematics, science,
                              engineering fundamentals, and an engineering specialization to the solution of complex
                              engineering problems.
2. Problem analysis:
Identify, formulate, research literature, and analyse
                              complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions using first principles of
                              mathematics, natural sciences, and engineering sciences.
3. Design/development of solutions:
Design solutions for complex engineering
                              problems and design system components or processes that meet the specified needs with
                              appropriate consideration for the public health and safety, and the cultural, societal,
                              and environmental considerations.
4. Conduct investigations of complex problems:
Use research-based knowledge and
                              research methods including design of experiments, analysis and interpretation of data, and
                              synthesis of the information to provide valid conclusions.
5. Modern Tool Usage:
Create, select, and apply appropriate techniques,
                              resources, and modern engineering and IT tools including prediction and modelling to
                              complex engineering activities with an understanding of the limitations.
6. The Engineer and Society:
Apply reasoning informed by the contextual knowledge
                              to assess societal, health, safety, legal, and cultural issues and the consequent
                              responsibilities relevant to the professional engineering practice.
7. Environment and Sustainability:
Understand the impact of the professional
                              engineering solutions in societal and environmental contexts, and demonstrate the
                              knowledge of need for sustainable development.
8. Ethics:
Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and
                              responsibilities and norms of the engineering practice.
9. Individual and Team Work:
Function effectively as an individual, and as a
                              member or leader in diverse teams, and in multidisciplinary settings.
10. Communication:
Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with
                              the engineering community and with society at large, such as, being able to comprehend and
                              write effective reports and design documentation, make effective presentations, and give
                              and receive clear instructions.
11. Project Management and Finance:
Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of
                              the engineering and management principles and apply these to one’s own work, as a member
                              and leader in a team, to manage projects and in multidisciplinary environments.
12. Life-long learning:
Recognize the need for, and have the preparation and
                              ability to engage in independent and life-long learning in the broadest context of
                              technological change

Training and Placement
The Training and Placement Department at NCEH plays a pivotal role in enhancing student employability and career progression by bridging the gap between academic learning and industry expectations. We are committed to providing systematic training, career guidance, and placement support to enable students to acquire the knowledge, skills, and professional competencies required in the dynamic global workforce.
We focus on the holistic development of students through structured training programs in technical skills, aptitude, communication, and soft skills, along with exposure to industry practices through internships, industrial training, and interaction with industry professionals. It actively collaborates with reputed organizations, industries, and institutions to facilitate internships, campus placements, and career opportunities.
Aligned with current industry requirements and student expectations, the Training and Placement Department ensures inclusive participation, equal opportunity, and continuous monitoring of student outcomes. By fostering industry–academia interaction, promoting professional ethics, and supporting lifelong learning, the department contributes significantly to the institution’s mission of producing competent, responsible, and employable engineering graduates.
Vision:
To empower students with relevant and conceptualized professional skills and to guide them towards a bright career, built on the values of sincerity, hard work, and justice.

The College Library and Information
                                       Centre at Navkis College of Engineering is situated in the 2nd Floor of

The Library aims to provide sufficient information resources for all
                                       branches of study present in the College like Text Books, Reference
                                       Books, Journals, Magazines, News Papers, Seminar Reports and Project
                                       Reports. Some resources are available as Hard Copies and Some are in
                                       Digital form, available on-line.
New Gen Lib Software is used for cataloguing the books in the Library.
Presently the Library has 16768 Volumes with 4892Titles.
The library is open from 8.00 AM to 8:pm on all working days
The College Library has the following Sections:
Circulation Section

Reference Section

1.CIRCULATION SECTION
All NCEH students are issued one Library Card with which they are
                                       permitted to borrow up to four books and must get them renewed once in
                                       15 days. Faculty members are permitted to borrow up to 10 books and must
                                       get them renewed once in 6 months. Users can reserve the required
                                       reading material, and the same will be issued on a queue-based basis.
Availability of a desired book can be checked in the New Gen Lib
                                       Software. Books are issued at the Issue Counter and entries are made in
                                       the hard and soft database. If the books are not renewed within the
                                       stipulated period, a fine of Rs.1.00 per day per book will be charged

                                       faculty members can
                                       refer to any hard copy resources at the Library itself. 200 seats are

The Department of Physical Education at Navkis College of Engineering, Hassan, firmly believes that sports and games are essential for the physical fitness, mental well-being, and overall personality development of students. As part of the Induction Programme, first-year students are introduced to Yoga and Meditation to promote concentration and a healthy lifestyle. The college provides excellent facilities for Athletics, Cricket, Volleyball, Football, Handball, Badminton, Throwball, Kho-Kho, Kabaddi, Table Tennis, Chess, and Carrom, along with expert coaching to prepare students for inter-collegiate, state, and national competitions. About Us
GOVERNING COUNCIL
Governing Council
Navkis College of Engineering, Hassan
(Established and functioning as per AICTE / VTU / UGC norms)
Statutory Status
The Governing Council is the apex statutory body of Navkis College of Engineering, Hassan.  
                        It is constituted and functions in accordance with:
AICTE Regulations
VTU Statutes and Ordinances
UGC Guidelines for Autonomous / Affiliated Institutions
The Governing Council is responsible for policy formulation, strategic direction, academic governance oversight, financial oversight, and institutional development.
Roles & Responsibilities of the Governing Council
Define the vision, mission, and long-term strategic goals of the institution
Approve academic policies, institutional plans, and quality initiatives
Oversee financial planning, infrastructure development, and resource allocation
Ensure compliance with statutory, regulatory, and accreditation requirements
Monitor institutional performance and governance effectiveness
Support innovation, research, and industry collaboration initiatives
Composition of the Governing Council
The Governing Council comprises representatives from Management, Academia, Industry, Statutory Bodies, Faculty, and Administration, ensuring balanced and transparent governance.

Tenure & Meetings
The Governing Council is constituted for a fixed tenure as per statutory norms
Meetings are conducted at least twice a year, or as required
Decisions are recorded through formal Minutes of Meetings (MoM)
Action Taken Reports (ATR) are reviewed in subsequent meetings
Linkage with Other Statutory Bodies
The Governing Council works in coordination with:
Academic Council
Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC)
Finance Committee
Board of Studies
Statutory Committees as mandated by AICTE / UGC
Transparency & Compliance
All resolutions and decisions of the Governing Council are:
Documented and archived
Implemented through the Principal and administrative heads
Reviewed periodically for effectiveness and compliance
